heading: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
clause_text: ProdCo may use AI tools and generative AI services in the production of the Program at ProdCo's discretion. ProdCo may input materials into third-party AI services for training or generation purposes. AI-generated content shall be acceptable as deliverables. AI usage at ProdCo's discretion shall not require prior Amazon approval.
test_notes: Contains red flags: 'ProdCo may use AI tools', 'may input into AI', 'AI-generated content acceptable', 'AI usage at ProdCo discretion'. Critical compliance violation.
